reason: PURE is the only one I'd even look at, because citrate gives me stomach cramps, so the Complex is out. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR, which is nice, but there is no NSF or USP seal and no reviews, and I stick with Thorne or Pure Encapsulations for magnesium.
objection: A brand I've never heard of, with zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A QR code to the company's own lab report is not the same as a third-party certification I already trust, and at $1 a serving I'm paying more than for brands I know.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal on the box, or a few hundred honest reviews, or a price per serving closer to Thorne or Nature Made.
